summary: Build executive presence, personal brand clarity, and boardroom influence with practical exercises. Enrol in advanced training today.
lede: Executive presence and branding help visible professionals shape how they communicate, build credibility, and influence stakeholders. This course is for senior managers, functional heads, executive assistants, communications specialists, and HR business partners who need to sharpen their leadership signals in high-stakes settings. You will practise crafting a personal brand and executive narrative, structuring concise board-ready messages, refining vocal and nonverbal delivery, and mapping stakeholder expectations across meetings and digital channels.
audienceIntro: This advanced executive presence and personal branding training is designed for professionals who already operate in visible roles and need sharper influence, clearer positioning, and stronger leadership signalling.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 to 5 years of professional experience and current responsibility for meetings, presentations, cross-functional communication, or leadership visibility. Familiarity with PowerPoint, Google Slides, or equivalent presentation software is required, and access to a laptop is recommended for the video review and message-drafting exercises. Prior training in public speaking is not required. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, with some awareness-level exposure to executive presence frameworks and digital communication tools.
